verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects has a first-party guide to managing projects through the GraphQL API. It covers querying project items, adding issues, PRs and draft issues, updating single-select field values, making a project public, and authenticating with personal access tokens or GitHub App installation tokens. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show no spec file at those docs.github.com paths; they do not contradict the documented GraphQL API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic use, and a machine-readable API spec located by the probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
